meta.agent: Subagent 1 — Package and Token Consistency Auditor
methodology: Read the source pack's token evidence in full: source-reference/source-tokens.json (68 canonical hex + 5 shadow rgba), tailwind.config.source.js, index.css.source, SOP_VISUAL_ONLY.md, source-reference/SOURCE_AUDIT_NOTES.md.
Read all 29 package files end-to-end (23 markdown, design-tokens.json, coverage-matrix.json, design-tokens.css, component-gallery.css/html/js).

Scripted CSS↔JSON parity (audits/subagent-1/audit_tool.py): parsed all 170 custom properties in design-tokens.css and all 148 token records in design-tokens.json, resolved var() references one level deep, compared values, role names, and classification tags against CSS comment tags.

Scripted WCAG 2.1 recomputation of every ratio claimed in the evidence panel (component-gallery.html:640-659), color-system.md, accessibility.md, design-tokens.css comments and design-tokens.json usage fields (33 claimed pairs + 14 additional implemented-but-unclaimed pairs); cross-checked against the run's own scripts/sub3-contrast.py and agents/sub3/contrast-results.json (both executed read-only).

Motion matrix built from the REQUIRED TIMING SYSTEM vs design-tokens.css:184-192 tokens, motion-interaction.md, overlay-system.md, component-contracts.md, the evidence panel (component-gallery.html:702-713), the actual transition/animation declarations in component-gallery.css (6 transitions, 2 animations), component-gallery.js timers, and computed-tokens.txt / behavior-* captures.
Prohibited-value scan across all 29 files (scripted): hex colors vs source ramp, rgba values, remote URLs, emoji/typographic symbols, TODO/TBD/FIXME/lorem markers, raw px font sizes below 12px.

Rendered-vs-documented: cross-checked all 25 capture files at audits/captures/ (computed-tokens, computed-structure, computed-fonts, behavior-*, current-ltr/rtl-*, overflow, console, network, page-errors) against documented claims; class-usage cross-check (classes in HTML/JS vs selectors in both CSS files).

Structure check: exact 29-file contract, flat layout, expected filenames per README file map, no extra artifacts; diffed the repos copy against download/visual-foundation-package-20260908T201936Z-g53-252a (identical).
Every finding below cites file + line or capture + value. Inferences are labeled (e.g. FAB overlap is CSS-math, not visually confirmed).

findings.evidence: design-tokens.css:184-192 (--motion-press: 120ms; --motion-fast: 200ms; --motion-base: 300ms; --motion-sheet: 340ms; no dialog or scrim tokens) vs REQUIRED TIMING SYSTEM; corroborated by computed-tokens.txt (motionPress 120ms, motionFast 200ms, motionBase 300ms, motionSheet 340ms) and component-gallery.css:126,191,260,292,300,448
findings.criterion: REQUIRED TIMING SYSTEM (run authority): press 80ms; fast 120ms; normal 200ms; sheet-in 240ms / sheet-out 180ms; dialog-in 160ms / dialog-out 120ms; scrim 200ms
findings.finding: Every implemented motion duration diverges from the required system: press is 120ms (required 80), fast is 200ms (required 120), normal/base is 300ms (required 200), sheet is a single 340ms token (required 240 in / 180 out), and dialog-in/dialog-out/scrim tokens do not exist at all. The current values are inherited from the source (index.css.source:51, tailwind.config.source.js:204-210, BottomSheet.jsx:150), so the package is source-faithful but run-authority-divergent.
findings.recommendation: Retokenize the motion block to the 8 required values (press 80 / fast 120 / normal 200 / sheet-in 240 / sheet-out 180 / dialog-in 160 / dialog-out 120 / scrim 200), retime every transition in component-gallery.css that consumes --motion-press/--motion-fast/--motion-base, and add the missing tokens with classification 'corrected' citing the run authority as evidence.

findings.evidence: component-gallery.css:464-468 (.scrim — no transition), :469-477 (.sheet — transform: translateY(0) with no transition/animation; [hidden] display:none), :503-509 (.dialog — no motion), :518-531 (.snackbar — no motion); component-gallery.js:171-188,224-232 (openOverlay/overlayClose/fireSnackbar only toggle the hidden attribute); design-tokens.css:293-300 defines @keyframes slideUp/slideDown/fadeIn/scaleIn/snackbarIn/ghostOut that are referenced by zero rules in component-gallery.css; grep confirms --motion-sheet and --snackbar-duration are never consumed anywhere in the gallery; captures behavior-sheet-open.txt / behavior-dialog-open.txt show instant state flips
findings.criterion: REQUIRED TIMING SYSTEM (scrim 200ms, sheet 240/180, dialog 160/120) + audit task 3d: 'check whether documented sheet/dialog motion is actually implemented in component-gallery.css (claimed vs actual)'
findings.finding: All documented overlay motion is claimed but not implemented. motion-interaction.md:34 ('Scrim fades 200ms; sheet slides 340ms ...; dialog scales in 200ms (scaleIn 0.95→1); snackbar slides+fade 300ms. Exits reverse: snackbar 300ms down+fade, sheet 340ms down, dialog 200ms fade+scale'), overlay-system.md:16,24,28,36, component-contracts.md:89, visual-direction.md:17 ('200–340ms overlay motion') and the evidence panel motion table (component-gallery.html:702-713) all describe motion that never runs: overlays appear and disappear instantly. Only spin (0.8s) and skeleton (1.5s) animations and 6 intra-component transitions actually execute.
findings.recommendation: Either implement the required in/out durations (the keyframes already exist in design-tokens.css and can be wired to .sheet/.dialog/.scrim/.snackbar with the new tokens) or retract the motion claims from all six documents and the evidence panel. Do not leave docs claiming motion the gallery never runs — this is the exact 'documented motion that never runs' class the repair run must close.

findings.evidence: motion-interaction.md:38 ('The source sheet is draggable: two snap points (collapsed 84vh, expanded 94vh) ... This package preserves the geometry and motion exactly'); overlay-system.md:11,17,44 ('Snap points collapsed ≤84vh · expanded 94vh', 'Drag up −50px expands...', 'Sheet (open, expanded snap, ... live drag-handle affordance)'); component-states.md:28 ('✅ open + expanded snap'); contrast: self-critique.md:18 admits 'the gallery sheet opens and closes without a draggable handle'; component-gallery.js contains no drag handlers; component-gallery.css:474 (.sheet max-height 84%, static)
findings.criterion: Internal cross-file consistency; rendered-vs-documented (audit task 4: documented behavior that does not run)
findings.finding: Two documents claim the package preserves source sheet drag 'exactly' and demonstrates 'live drag' and 'expanded snap', while self-critique.md truthfully states drag is not interactive, and the code confirms it (no pointer/drag handlers, single static 84% max-height, no 94vh expanded state). The drag contract itself is fine as a spec; the claim that it is 'preserved exactly' / demonstrated live is false and contradicted by the package's own self-critique.
findings.recommendation: Align motion-interaction.md and overlay-system.md with self-critique.md: describe the drag geometry as specified-from-source, not preserved/demonstrated; remove 'live drag-handle affordance' and 'expanded snap' from the gallery-demonstrations claims (or implement drag).

(component-gallery.html:503-510, confirmed by behavior-sheet-open-snapshot.txt); component-states.md:14 marks Input-search '✅ (trailing spinner)' — no spinner exists in the search field (html:181-187; js has no search-loading code); component-states.md:24 marks Row '✅ (error row variant)' — rows at html:372-416 have no error variant; component-states.md:31 marks Snackbar '✅ (error variant)' — all fired messages are success/info (js:233-240,278-292,296-306); component-states.md:28 '✅ open + expanded snap' (see S1-03); navigation-shell.md:38 claims 'large-title subheader, bottom nav with all five destinations' — the gallery has no large-title demo (grep: --topbar-height-large never consumed) and exactly 4 nav items (html:445-462, confirmed in behavior-sheet-open-snapshot.txt); responsive-geometry.md:22 claims 'the gallery renders them: a 5-segment segmented control ... 5-destination nav' — the gallery segmented control has 3 segments (html:281-286)

findings.recommendation: Correct component-states.md ✅ marks and coverage-matrix.json statuses to 'specified' for the nonexistent states, fix the 4/5 destination and 3/5 segment counts, and drop the large-title claim (or add the demo).
